title: Rhythm Copycat
shareTitle: Rhythm Copycat 🥁 — copy Kiki's claps, stomps, taps and shakes
description: Kiki the kawaii kitten plays a tiny beat. Listen, then copy it back on four big friendly pads — clap, stomp, tap and shake!
learningGoals: Hear and copy short body-percussion rhythm patterns
Match sounds to actions in a steady sequence
Grow pattern memory from two beats to four
interactionModel: pick a beat card, watch Kiki play the pattern on the pads, then copy it by tapping the same big pads in order
feedbackModel: every beat can be finished: a wrong pad wiggles with a spoken nudge and the right pad glows after two tries; every finished beat ends in stars, confetti and a song

modes.title: Drum Beat
modes.skill: copy 2-4 beat clap and stomp patterns

modes.title: Jingle Beat
modes.skill: copy 2-4 beat tap and shake patterns

modes.title: Parade Beat
modes.skill: copy patterns mixing all four actions
